title: 雷电将军 · 离岛海滨的清凉微风
description: 离岛的午后海风掠过白沙，雷电影穿着深紫色泳装站在浅浅的浪线旁。她双手扶着遮阳伞柄，回过头确认你是否跟上，长长的紫色发辫被风带向一侧。伞影刚好遮住她的脸，露出带着一点拘谨的浅笑，身后的蓝海与云层在日光里显得格外明亮。
location: 离岛蔚蓝海岸的白沙滩
action: 赤足站在白沙浅浪旁，双手扶遮阳伞柄，回眸露出拘谨的浅笑。
camera: full body, eye level, seaside portrait
promptProse: Afternoon wind carries Raiden Ei's long purple braid sideways along the white beach at Ritou. She stands barefoot beside the shallow foam in her purple swimsuit, both hands steadying a parasol handle. Turning back to check that the viewer has followed, she offers a small, slightly awkward smile beneath the parasol shade. Clear blue water and sunlit clouds fill the distance. The full-length eye-level portrait keeps her feet, parasol and coastline together.

title: 雷电将军 · 鸣神神社的落樱
description: 鸣神神社的石阶上铺着绯樱花瓣，红白鸟居在黄昏里透出温暖的颜色。雷电影身着紫色将军袍，站在神樱树下，伸出一只手接住刚落下的花瓣，另一手自然垂在腰侧。她先看了片刻掌心，再转向身旁的你，长辫轻轻拂过衣袖，目光里带着安静的追忆。
location: 鸣神神社神樱与鸟居之间
action: 站在神樱树下伸掌接住一片落樱，再回头看向视角，另一手自然放在腰侧。
camera: medium shot, eye level, falling petals in foreground
promptProse: A single cherry petal settles on Raiden Ei's open palm beneath the Sacred Sakura. Standing in her purple shogun robes between the tree and the shrine torii, she studies it before turning toward the viewer with quiet recognition. Her other hand hangs relaxed beside the obi, and the long braid brushes her sleeve. Sunset warms the red gates and petal-covered stone steps. Frame her face and open hand in a medium portrait with a few petals drifting in front.

title: 雷电将军 · 花海逆光
description: 晚风吹过郊野的波斯菊，雷电影穿着长袖紫色便裙，在花田小径上停下脚步。她回身望向你，紫色长辫垂在肩后，辫梢与衣裙一同被风轻轻带起。夕阳沿着她的侧脸镀出暖边，花海在身后缓缓摇动，她伸出一只空着的手，像是邀请你把剩下的路一起走完。
action: 站在花田小径上回身伸手，长辫与裙摆随晚风轻扬，露出温柔浅笑。
camera: medium shot, eye level, meadow extending behind subject
promptProse: Between swaying cosmos flowers, Raiden Ei stops on the narrow meadow path and turns to invite the viewer forward with an open hand. Her long-sleeved purple dress moves in the breeze, and the familiar single braid rests behind her shoulder. A gentle smile softens her face as low sunset light traces its edge. Use a medium view with a broad stretch of flowers behind her, holding the quiet pause before they continue along the path.

title: 雷电将军 · 午后咖啡馆
description: 咖啡馆临窗的木桌上放着一杯温热的抹茶拿铁，表面的奶泡还留着小小的叶形拉花。雷电影穿紫色长袖便裙，一手轻扶杯耳，另一手把细玻璃吸管停在唇边，刚尝到甜味便微微弯起眼睛。长辫落在肩后，窗外街景变得模糊，她把这段安静的午后留给了与你的闲谈。
action: 坐在窗边一手扶杯耳，另一手持细玻璃吸管小口品尝抹茶拿铁，目光放松。
camera: medium close-up, eye level, cup and face visible
promptProse: The first sweet sip of a warm matcha latte brings a relaxed smile to Raiden Ei at the cafe window. One hand steadies the ceramic mug by its handle while the other holds a slender glass straw at her lips. A small leaf of latte art remains on the foam. Her purple long-sleeved dress and long braid are lit by soft afternoon window light, with the street blurred beyond. Keep the mug, straw and face clear in this close table portrait.
